C_links.note: Heuristics exist for links nobody has reported yet; in production the blocklist runs too. A flagged legit link is held only when the message also asks for money; otherwise the guest sees a warning.

E_cost_latency.note: ESTIMATE, not a bill: input tokens = prompt characters / 4, output = 150 tokens per judge, 2 judges. Latency is in-process, excludes network and DB, and the judge path ran offline-deterministic; a hosted LLM adds an estimated 1-3 s to judged messages only.
